UPDATE yunzhanghu_unsign_reconciliations
            SET lease_owner = NULL,
                lease_expires_at = NULL,
                last_error = 'marker_appeared_after_claim',
                next_attempt_at = NOW() + ($3::double precision * INTERVAL '1 second'),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE nonce = $1
              AND status = 'pending'
              AND lease_owner = $2
